name: ascet_code_read
description: Read the current source of one ASCET search result by component_oid and document_id. Reads only that component's sources after directory lookup; does not reuse search snapshots. expected_database is required; optional expected_source_sha256 rejects changed content with SOURCE_CHANGED. Returns document.text, metadata, SHA-256 and logical line_count. Original text retains original line endings. State-machine documents retain diagram/hierarchy/element/slot identity. A binding document contains the bound method name; graphical_method documents contain a derived graphical representation with GET/SET ports and connections, not original ESDL or generated C. Unsupported graph logic is explicitly partial. Same persistent JSONL process as ascet_code_search; operation must be read.
